notes.zh-Hant:
• 錄音畫面上方的狀態條微調：計時不折行、開關排得更整齊
• 「沒人說話自動停止」選單加上小標題
notes.en:
• Recording status bar polish: the timer no longer wraps, switches are evenly spaced
• The auto-stop menu now has a heading

notes.zh-Hant:
• 錄音畫面改版：上方縮成一條，計時、音波與三個開關（螢幕不鎖、沒人說話自動停止、鎖屏不顯示）都在這裡
• 開始錄音先顯示逐字稿頁，按 ★ 切回重點
• 手機溫度用顏色表示：正常綠、偏熱橘、很燙紫
• 內螢幕兩欄排版對齊
notes.en:
• Redesigned recording screen: a single bar at the top with the timer, level meter and three switches (keep screen on, auto-stop on silence, hide on lock screen)
• Recording opens on the transcript page; tap ★ to go back to highlights
• Phone temperature shown in color: green normal, orange warm, purple hot
• Two-column layout on the inner screen lines up

notes.zh-Hant: • 電量低或過熱降級恢復後，即時逐字稿不再重複整理同一段
notes.en: • After low battery or overheating slowdowns end, the live transcript no longer processes the same stretch twice

notes.zh-Hant:
• 逐字稿字級調整，更好讀
• 大字體時單場頁的按鈕不再擠在一起
notes.en:
• Transcript text sizes adjusted for easier reading
• Meeting page buttons no longer crowd together with large text

notes.zh-Hant:
• 錄音中的逐字稿頁往上捲不會再被拉回，有「回到最新」可按
• 即時逐字稿更穩定
• 命名頁與匯入的等待畫面改善
notes.en:
• Scrolling up on the live transcript no longer jumps back; tap Back to latest
• More reliable live transcript
• Better waiting screens when naming and importing

notes.zh-Hant:
• 錄音中的逐字稿頁講完約 10 秒就出字
• 錄音畫面拿掉電量顯示
• 命名頁的「存檔中」改成卡片，不擋操作
notes.en:
• The live transcript shows text about 10 seconds after someone speaks
• Battery level removed from the recording screen
• "Saving" on the naming page is now a card

notes.zh-Hant:
• 產生會議紀錄時，進度條照實際進度走
• 產生時手機不會自動鎖屏
• 錯誤訊息改成建議上傳 ChatGPT 或 Claude
notes.en:
• The meeting notes progress bar follows real progress
• The phone stays awake while notes are generated
• Error messages now suggest uploading to ChatGPT or Claude

notes.zh-Hant:
• 支援 Android 11
• 不能用 Gemini Nano 的手機不再顯示這個選項
• 會議紀錄草稿產完直接打開
• 修正 Android 12 開「裝置資訊」會閃退
notes.en:
• Supports Android 11
• Gemini Nano is hidden on phones that can't use it
• Meeting drafts open as soon as they're ready
• Fixed a crash opening Device info on Android 12

notes.zh-Hant: • 可以在 App 裡更新：開 App 時檢查新版，或到「設定 › 關於 › 檢查更新」
notes.en: • In-app updates: checks for a new version when the app opens, or go to Settings › About › Check for updates
